description: T3 Ops product screens for /software/t3-ops (plan 2026-11-04, section 5.2). Local demo with fictional .example data on http://localhost:3001 (see var/research/t3ops-demo.md). Capture with Build/Scripts/capture-app-screenshots.mjs --base http://localhost:3001 --shots <this file> --state <signed-in storage state>; the illustrations come from a static page on http://127.0.0.1:8765 that shows dashboard/public/help/infographics/*.webp. Never press Start in the update assistant.

steps.evaluate: (() => { for (const phrase of ['Updates cannot be dispatched right now']) { const hit = [...document.querySelectorAll('main *')].find((e) => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === phrase); let box = hit; while (box && box.parentElement && box.parentElement.textContent.trim().startsWith(phrase)) box = box.parentElement; box?.remove(); } })()
